upgrade.speed.tip: Trim seconds off every cycle. The classic first move.
upgrade.machine.tip: A second machine working in parallel. Capacity +1, arguments about bench space included.
upgrade.tooling.tip: Sharper dies and truer fixtures — fewer parts take the walk of shame to the scrap bin.
upgrade.smed.tip: Faster tool swaps mean less downtime between jobs and more time actually making things.
skill.powered_conveyors.name: Powered Conveyors
skill.powered_conveyors.tip: Motorized belts pace the whole line — and from here on you can watch flow visibly speed up as you improve it.
skill.kanban.name: Kanban
skill.kanban.tip: Cards that say 'only make more when the next station asks.' Smaller piles, smoother flow.
skill.value_stream_map.name: Value Stream Mapping
skill.value_stream_map.tip: Draw every step from raw steel to sold gizmo. Waste has nowhere left to hide.
skill.spaghetti_diagram.name: Spaghetti Diagram
skill.spaghetti_diagram.tip: Trace every walk an operator takes in a shift, then untangle the noodles.
skill.heijunka.name: Heijunka
skill.heijunka.tip: Level the schedule so no station gets slammed on Monday and naps on Friday.
skill.one_piece_flow.name: One-Piece Flow
skill.one_piece_flow.tip: Pass one part at a time instead of one pallet at a time — problems surface in minutes, not shifts.
skill.cellular_layout.name: Cellular Layout
skill.cellular_layout.tip: Group machines by product, not by department. Parts stop commuting across the plant.
skill.water_spider.name: Water Spider
skill.water_spider.tip: One dedicated runner keeps every station fed, so operators never have to leave their posts.
skill.pull_system.name: Pull System
skill.pull_system.tip: Downstream demand pulls work through the line. Nothing gets built on a hunch.
skill.drum_buffer_rope.name: Drum-Buffer-Rope
skill.drum_buffer_rope.tip: March the whole line to the bottleneck's drumbeat — Theory of Constraints, the very game you are playing.
skill.five_s.name: 5S
skill.five_s.tip: Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain. A clean station is a station you can trust.
skill.autonomous_maintenance.name: Autonomous Maintenance
skill.autonomous_maintenance.tip: Operators own the daily wipe-downs and bolt checks. Breakdowns stop being surprises.
skill.root_cause_analysis.name: Root Cause Analysis
skill.root_cause_analysis.tip: Ask 'why' five times and fix the cause, not the symptom. Yes, like a toddler. It works.
skill.preventive_maintenance.name: Preventive Maintenance
skill.preventive_maintenance.tip: Service machines on a calendar, not on a breakdown.
skill.oee_dashboard.name: OEE Dashboard
skill.oee_dashboard.tip: One honest number for how much of your factory is actually working. Watch it climb.
skill.tpm.name: Total Productive Maintenance
skill.tpm.tip: Everyone from operator to manager keeps the machines healthy. Uptime becomes a team sport.
skill.spare_parts_kanban.name: Point-of-Use Spares
skill.spare_parts_kanban.tip: Wire, tips and nozzles stocked right at the cell — the weld bay stops phoning the parts crib.
skill.condition_monitoring.name: Condition Monitoring
skill.condition_monitoring.tip: Sensors hear a bearing whine before it screams. You fix it during lunch.
skill.lights_out_shift.name: Lights-Out Shift
skill.lights_out_shift.tip: The line keeps running while you're away. The machines don't miss you. Honestly.
skill.zero_breakdowns.name: Zero Breakdowns
skill.zero_breakdowns.tip: The TPM dream: machines that simply do not stop unless asked nicely.
skill.check_sheets.name: Check Sheets
skill.check_sheets.tip: Tally marks on a clipboard — the humble ancestor of every quality system on Earth.
skill.andon_cord.name: Andon Cord
skill.andon_cord.tip: Anyone can stop the line the moment something looks wrong. Bad parts get caught, not shipped.
skill.poka_yoke.name: Poka-Yoke
skill.poka_yoke.tip: Mistake-proof the fixture so the part only fits the right way round. Genius optional.
skill.spc.name: Statistical Process Control
skill.spc.tip: Control charts that whisper 'drifting…' long before parts actually go bad.
skill.rework_loop.name: Rework Loop
skill.rework_loop.tip: A scrapped part still has good metal in it. Recover some of the value.
skill.jidoka.name: Jidoka
skill.jidoka.tip: Machines smart enough to stop themselves when they make a bad part — automation with a human touch.
skill.certified_supplier.name: Certified Supplier
skill.certified_supplier.tip: When your defects become a rumor, customers pay a premium.
skill.dmaic.name: Six Sigma (DMAIC)
skill.dmaic.tip: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control — statistics wearing safety glasses.
skill.quality_at_source.name: Quality at the Source
skill.quality_at_source.tip: Every station inspects its own work. Final inspection stops playing goalie.
skill.built_in_quality.name: Built-In Quality
skill.built_in_quality.tip: Quality designed into the process itself. The scrap bin starts collecting dust.
skill.time_study.name: Time Study
skill.time_study.tip: Stand at the line with a stopwatch and learn where seconds go to die.
skill.smed_workshop.name: SMED
skill.smed_workshop.tip: Single-Minute Exchange of Die: changeovers in minutes, not coffee breaks. Pit crews perfected it.
skill.quick_change_tooling.name: Quick-Change Tooling
skill.quick_change_tooling.tip: Clamps and pre-set jigs instead of bolts and prayer.
skill.standard_work.name: Standard Work
skill.standard_work.tip: Write down today's best way to do the job — then beat it next month.
skill.takt_time_tuning.name: Takt Time Tuning
skill.takt_time_tuning.tip: Match every station's pace to the customer's heartbeat. No faster, no slower.
skill.motion_kaizen.name: Motion Kaizen
skill.motion_kaizen.tip: Shave wasted reaches, turns and steps until the work almost does itself.
skill.line_balancing.name: Line Balancing
skill.line_balancing.tip: Shift work between stations until nobody is idle and nobody is drowning.
skill.external_setup.name: External Setup
skill.external_setup.tip: Prep the next changeover while the machine is still running the last job.
skill.chaku_chaku.name: Chaku-Chaku
skill.chaku_chaku.tip: 'Load-load': the operator drops a part in and walks on; machines eject their own.
skill.flow_at_takt.name: Flow at Takt
skill.flow_at_takt.tip: The whole line breathing in rhythm — the quiet hum of a plant at peace.
skill.morning_huddle.name: Morning Huddle
skill.morning_huddle.tip: Five minutes at the whiteboard so the whole crew rows in the same direction.
skill.cross_training.name: Cross-Training
skill.cross_training.tip: Everyone can run at least two stations. Lunch breaks stop being outages.
skill.suggestion_system.name: Suggestion System
skill.suggestion_system.tip: The best ideas come from whoever is holding the wrench. Reward them — in points.
skill.gemba_walks.name: Gemba Walks
skill.gemba_walks.tip: Go to the real place, watch the real work, ask real questions. The Tab key does this literally.
skill.institutional_memory.name: Institutional Memory
skill.institutional_memory.tip: Write everything down. The next factory you run starts smarter — and richer.
skill.kaizen_circles.name: Kaizen Circles
skill.kaizen_circles.tip: Small teams meeting weekly to chip away at problems before they grow up.
skill.kaizen_blitz.name: Kaizen Blitz
skill.kaizen_blitz.tip: A focused improvement sprint: same factory, suddenly cheaper to improve.
skill.second_shift.name: Second Shift
skill.second_shift.tip: A night crew keeps the line earning while you're off being a person.
skill.twi_program.name: Training Within Industry
skill.twi_program.tip: The 1940s playbook that taught industry how to teach. Still undefeated.
skill.hoshin_kanri.name: Hoshin Kanri
skill.hoshin_kanri.tip: Point every improvement at the same true north. Effort stops canceling itself out.
skill.ci_manager.name: CI Manager
skill.ci_manager.tip: A Continuous Improvement manager who buys the best upgrade for you. Delegation: the final lean tool.
ach.ACH_FIRST_PART.name: Day One
ach.ACH_FIRST_PART.desc: Ship your first gizmo. Frame the invoice.
ach.ACH_PARTS_100.name: Batch of a Hundred
ach.ACH_PARTS_100.desc: Make 100 parts. The line is officially a line.
ach.ACH_PARTS_10K.name: Ten Thousand Strong
ach.ACH_PARTS_1M.name: Gizmo Millionaire
ach.ACH_PARTS_1M.desc: Make 1,000,000 parts. Somewhere, a warehouse groans.
ach.ACH_PARTS_100M.name: Heavy Industry
ach.ACH_PARTS_100M.desc: Make 100,000,000 parts. You are a supply chain now.
ach.ACH_MONEY_1K.name: First Grand
ach.ACH_MONEY_100K.name: Six Figures
ach.ACH_MONEY_10M.name: Serious Revenue
ach.ACH_MONEY_10M.desc: Earn 10,000,000 lifetime. Accounting sends a fruit basket.
ach.ACH_PPS_1.name: One a Second
ach.ACH_PPS_10.name: Double Digits
ach.ACH_PPS_100.name: The Firehose
ach.ACH_PPS_100.desc: Reach 100 parts per second. Please stand clear of the chute.
ach.ACH_OEE_85.name: The 85% Club
ach.ACH_OEE_85.desc: Hold OEE at 85% — the number plant managers frame on the wall.
ach.ACH_ZERO_SCRAP_HOUR.name: Golden Hour
ach.ACH_ZERO_SCRAP_HOUR.desc: Run a full hour without scrapping a single part.
ach.ACH_HERBIE.name: Finding Herbie
ach.ACH_HERBIE.desc: Clear 3 bottlenecks. Every line has a Herbie. (Read The Goal.)
ach.ACH_WHACK_A_MOLE.name: Whack-a-Mole
ach.ACH_WHACK_A_MOLE.desc: Clear 25 bottlenecks. The constraint always moves. Always.
ach.ACH_FLOW_STATE.name: Flow State
ach.ACH_CONSTRAINT_WHISPERER.name: Constraint Whisperer
ach.ACH_CONSTRAINT_WHISPERER.desc: Clear 500 bottlenecks. You can hear the line thinking.
ach.ACH_FRESH_COAT.name: Fresh Coat
ach.ACH_SOME_ASSEMBLY.name: Some Assembly Required
ach.ACH_SHIP_IT.name: Ship It
ach.ACH_SHIP_IT.desc: Bring QA & Packout online. The whole line, end to end.
ach.ACH_UPGRADES_25.name: Tinkerer
ach.ACH_UPGRADES_100.name: Machine Shop Regular
ach.ACH_UPGRADES_100.desc: Install 100 upgrades. The vendors know your coffee order.
ach.ACH_UPGRADES_500.name: Capital Expenditure
ach.ACH_FIRST_SKILL.name: Student of Flow
ach.ACH_SKILLS_15.name: Lean Practitioner
ach.ACH_SKILLS_ALL.name: Sensei
ach.ACH_SKILLS_ALL.desc: Learn every skill on the tree. Now teach someone else.
ach.ACH_KAIZEN_1.name: Under New Management
ach.ACH_KAIZEN_3.name: Serial Improver
ach.ACH_KAIZEN_7.name: Change Is the Only Constant
ach.ACH_WORLD_CLASS.name: World Class
ach.ACH_WORLD_CLASS.desc: Hold 15 Kaizen Events. Toyota would like a word. A kind one.
hint.hint_starved: A station is starving — its input bin is empty. The real problem is upstream: speed up the station before it.
hint.hint_afford_fix: You can afford an upgrade at the bottleneck right now. That is always money well spent.
hint.hint_stuck_90: The same station has been the constraint for a while. Focus your spending there — improving anything else improves nothing.
hint.hint_stuck_300: Stubborn bottleneck? Cycle time isn't the only lever. Uptime, quality and changeover all feed throughput.
hint.hint_kp_3: Kaizen Points are sitting idle on your clipboard. Idle anything is waste — open the skill tree.
hint.hint_kp_10: Ten-plus Kaizen Points unspent. The suggestion box is overflowing. Go approve something.
hint.hint_prestige: You can hold a Kaizen Event: trade this line in for a faster one. Skills, points and know-how all carry over.
hint.hint_gemba: Press Tab to walk the floor. Problems look different from where the work actually happens.
hint.hint_watch: Watch the line flow: parts pile up in front of the slowest station, and red means 'fix me first.'
hint.hint_buffers: Big piles between stations feel safe, but they just hide problems. Lean folk say 'inventory' the way sailors say 'leak.'
ui.offline_body: The night shift kept the line running: {0} earned in {1}.
ui.offline_capped: (offline cap reached — the crew went home)
ui.prestige_explain: Sell this factory and commission a better one. Stations, money and WIP reset — your skills, Kaizen Points and lean know-how carry over, and every CI Point permanently speeds up the whole line.
ui.prestige_confirm: Hold the Kaizen Event? This factory is reset. Your knowledge is not.
ui.prestige_locked: Reach {0} lifetime parts to hold a Kaizen Event.
ui.toast_import_ok: Save imported. Welcome back to the floor.
ui.toast_import_fail: That save string didn't pass inspection.
ui.orbit_hint: Tab — back to the manager's view
ui.prestige_done_body: +{0} CI Points — the whole line now runs at {1}.
ui.effect_starting_money_add: +{0} starting money after a Kaizen Event
ui.effect_auto_buyer: CI manager buys the best upgrade every {0}s
ui.upeffect_toward_one: {0} closes {1} of the gap to 100% per level
ui.tip_money: Cash from sold parts. Spend it on station upgrades and unlocks.
ui.tip_pps: Finished parts sold per second at the end of the line.
ui.tip_oee: Overall Equipment Effectiveness: actual output vs. the line's theoretical best. World-class plants hit ~85%.
ui.tip_bottleneck: The slowest station sets the pace of the whole line (Theory of Constraints). Fix it first — click to jump to it.
ui.tip_kp: Kaizen Points — earned at milestones. Spend them in the Skill Tree.
ui.tip_cip: Continuous Improvement Points from Kaizen Events. Each one permanently speeds up every future factory.
ui.tip_buy_mult: How many upgrade levels each click buys. MAX buys as many as you can afford.
ui.tip_throughput: Good parts this station finishes per second.
ui.tip_quality: Share of parts that pass inspection. The rest become scrap.
ui.tip_wip: Work In Progress waiting in front of this station. A full buffer blocks the station upstream.
ui.tip_unlock: Extends the line with a new station. A longer line sells parts for more.
ui.tip_upgrade_speed: Faster cycles (takt time): the machine finishes each part sooner.
ui.tip_upgrade_machine: Adds a parallel machine so the station works several parts at once.
ui.tip_upgrade_tooling: Better tooling and poka-yoke: fewer defects, less scrap.
ui.tip_upgrade_smed: Quick changeover (SMED): swap tooling in seconds instead of minutes, so less time is lost between runs.
save.corrupt_new_game: Your save file was corrupted — starting a new game.
